content:
- Model consistently underestimates true prices, especially in the first 10–15 days of the forecast horizon.
- Model overreacts to recent spikes (e.g., 70+ values) by overshooting into 72+ in subsequent days.
- Model fails to capture mean reversion toward lower levels after sharp spikes (e.g., 73+ → 70+).
- Forecast tends to lag behind true price movements by 2–5 days, particularly in upward trends.
- Model exhibits persistent bias toward lower values in the final 5–10 days of the forecast, suggesting underweighting of near-term volatility.
- Overestimates volatility in early forecast days when prices are trending upward, then underestimates later in the horizon.
